summary: Round two, and every figure in the round-two prose was re-measured independently rather than read. Review compiled a probe against this tree's own build outputs (no gradle, no tree mutation) and ran the same profile the sweep runs -- (0.03,0.03,0.1,0.02,0.02,0.02), 3 pods -- over seeds 0..999 at ROUNDS=120 and again at ROUNDS=3. Measured: trace 160,478 and ack-kind 11,110 (149.37 / 11.11 per seed, the stated 93/7); cumulative-prefix minimum against 3N is 1.9583 at N=8 with the prefix carrying 47 events; against 5N the minimum is 1.1750 and 47/64 = 0.734 for 8N -- so the four sizings in the comment are exact and 'no prefix below 3N, or below 5N either' holds over all 1,000 prefixes, not a sample; N=1 is 2.6667x, so the tightest prefix is indeed NOT N=1 here, unlike the readers and mixture floors above it; at ROUNDS=3 the ack half is 1,017, so SEEDS*1 = 1,000 does stay green by seventeen events while SEEDS*3 reds by 2.950x, and the mixture floor reds too at 3,553 against 5,000 -- which is the sentence that says the workload is not what distinguishes the two floors. The zero-ack figures the parenthetical keeps are right as well: 12 such seeds, earliest 197, seed 0 emits 8, and no seed emits an empty trace (per-seed trace minimum 45). Nothing passed at round one broke: the two hunks are the accumulator and the assertion, the upper comment block loses only restated figures and the retired 'M5.50 owns' clause while keeping 30.60x, which is its own, and the new block is the single owner of all five figures. Both files' changes are prose, an accumulator and one assertion in a test; no production code, no object-store request, no LIST, no per-record or per-shard path -- the added work is one stream over an in-memory list already being sized on the line above, ~160k elements across the whole sweep. The deferred round-one minor is routed rather than re-raised: M5.67 is staged in this same commit, and review confirms its load-bearing premise directly -- ackKindEvents == commits + zombieWrites held on all 1,000 seeds with zero breaks (zombieWrites 0), so today's new floor is implied by the commits floor twenty lines up except for the one bit it does add, that the emission exists at all, which is exactly what the strip-the-acks demonstration kills. Re-raising that in round two would be the churn review.md rule 11 names.
